status: research design frozen before new model experiments; press data already explored

input.deduplicate: same timestamp and all three sensor values; preserve source-row mapping
input.primary_vibration_preprocessing: subtract mean of each completed record, identically for both classes
input.robust_scale: 1.4826 MAD, fallback IQR/1.349, else omit feature

B2.type: v2 structure refit on common folds

B3.type: mean distance to k nearest reference records
B3.distance: Euclidean on 7 common standardized axes; drop unscalable axes, fit-median impute
B3.fit_diagnostics: exclude all children of query parent

C1.type: two-sided conditional vibration residual plus current deviation

C2.type: upper-sided conditional vibration residual plus current deviation

condition_proxy.fallback: global vibration, retain current anomaly score
condition_proxy.regression_objective: mean squared error + 0.001 * sum of squared non-intercept coefficients
condition_proxy.polynomial_scaling: form log A and squared log A columns first; standardize each with fit mean/std

calibration.method: split empirical rank of one combined score
calibration.tie_rule: count calibration scores >= query, plus one in numerator and denominator
calibration.guarantee: none under unverified dependence/drift; report realized rates

augmentation.heldout_parents: P2 evaluation; generated after final selection
augmentation.rng_key: purpose, fold, original parent, family, seed; shared base realization across amplitude grid

probability.head: nonnegative-slope logistic, L2 coefficient 1, standardized score; total weights normalized to number of head-fit records
probability.head_objective: sum(w_i * BCE_i)/N + 0.5 * a^2; a >= 0; no intercept penalty
probability.q_sensitivity_fit: refit head for each q using same registered objective

policy.secondary: 2-of-3, reset after gap >30s, resolve after 2 normal records
policy.slow_challenger: EWMA lambda=0.2, its own complete policy calibration
policy.baseline_adaptation: off by default; confirmed-normal delayed feedback only

selection.require_direction_consistency: both development-fold means; per-seed normal-burden and loss limits must also pass
selection.condition_strata: before injection; post-injection gate changes reported separately
selection.reference: B1 for candidate selection; same unaugmented learner for added augmentation effect, also retain B1 comparison
selection.aggregation: mean of 3 seeds within original parent; equal weights for two registered amplitudes within family; pool folds by parent count
eligible_candidate_order: fewest total normal requests including quality/abstention
highest minimum representative POD across 3 development families
fewest fitted parameters and stored references

external.skab_label_conflicts: mask from normal training/calibration; retain ambiguous coverage and evaluation bounds
external.beihang_reserved: Healthy state/2.csv and all nine fault files

skab_unit.anchor: first observation in deduplicated capture group, independent of labels
skab_unit.gap_reset: greater than 1.5 times fit median sampling interval
skab_unit.cal: one score per complete unambiguously normal block
skab_unit.evaluation: same block score and decision unit; unfinished blocks retained in coverage
